honing_confound: 4-Stack Ruin damage scales with Magic attack power (gear honing). Crit rate investment from Specialization stat also gear-dependent. Tier standing reflects T4 stack-detonation efficiency.

delivery.evidence: Arcanist skills are card-themed ranged attacks. Stacking skills (build 4 stacks on targets): Card Explosion, Seize, Scratch Dealer. Ruin skills (detonate stacks): Spiral Blade, Quadra Accelerate, Evoke, Checkmate. Mix of targeted single-target and AoE delivery.

footprint.evidence: Arcanist skills have moderate range and footprint — not as wide as Sorceress AoE. Stack-Ruin skills are semi-targeted. Card Deck skills have variable footprint depending on card drawn.

geo_text: Medium-range card-caster. Empress's Grace Arcanist executes a strict stack-ruin loop: apply 4 stacks to targets using Stacking skills → detonate with Ruin skills for amplified damage. Tarot cards from the Card Deck provide additional damage, cooldown resets, and damage multipliers. Spatial identity is medium-range with deliberate skill sequencing.

control.evidence: Some Arcanist skills have knockback/displacement effects. No primary CC identity — damage and stack-ruin is the focus. Card draws may add CC effects (deck randomness).

defense.evidence: Mage archetype — light armor, glass profile. No dedicated defensive mechanic in Empress's Grace identity. Blink/teleport skills provide escape.

economy.resource_verbatim: Arcane Energy (Identity Gauge) + Stacks (target debuff, up to 4)
economy.builder_source: All skill damage fills Arcane Energy gauge. SEPARATELY: Stacking skills apply Stack debuffs (1-2 per hit, up to 4 per target) independent of gauge.
economy.plain_text: DUAL ECONOMY: (1) Arcane Energy meter fills via damage → draws one random Tarot card (held up to 2). Cards: Power card = damage buff; Chain card = cooldown reset; Wild card = randomized effect. (2) Stack-Ruin loop: Stacking skills apply 1-2 stacks per hit on target (max 4). Ruin skills detonate ALL stacks for amplified damage. EMPRESS'S GRACE BONUS: 4-Stack Ruin damage significantly increased. The identity is a strict BUILD STACKS → DETONATE rotation that requires deliberate skill sequencing.

element.evidence: Arcanist deals Magic/Arcane damage. Card-based theme. Some skills deal specific element types (fire card, wind card) but overall identity is Arcane.

movement.evidence: Arcanist has better mobility than Sorceress — smaller commits per skill. Blink available. Stack application during movement not confirmed but implied by ability to use multiple stacking skills in sequence.

attr.evidence: Arcanist engages at medium range — not melee, not as far as Sorceress. Cards reach is moderate.

range.evidence: Estimated from class archetype. Not confirmed with exact distances from live sourcing.

tempo.evidence: Empress's Grace is the burst identity: the goal is to reach 4-stack detonation as efficiently as possible. Between detonations = building stacks. Detonation = burst. Clear build-release rhythm.

amp.value: 4-Stack Ruin: significantly increased damage (Empress's Grace bonus); Tarot card buffs as secondary amplification
amp.evidence: Directly sourced: 'Empress's Grace increases the damage of 4-Stack Ruin damage.' Exact percentage not confirmed from live sources — conf 0.85.

proxy.evidence: No proxy mechanics. Cards are triggered effects, not persistent entities.

commitment.evidence: Key Ruin skills (Quadra Accelerate, Checkmate) have wind-up animations. Stack application skills are faster casts.

mechanics_notes: 1) The Stack-Ruin system is the genre's most mechanically explicit 'setup-payoff' skill interaction: up to 4 discrete charges on target, detonated by a separate skill category. No other game in the corpus has this exact mechanic — it's Arcanist-specific and highly distinctive. 2) The Tarot card randomness (random draw from 12-card deck) introduces a luck layer that modifies every rotation differently. Cards like Chain (cooldown reset) can extend burst windows; others add flat damage. This proc-layer on top of the deterministic stack-ruin loop makes Arcanist the most probabilistic kit in LA. 3) EMPRESS'S GRACE IDENTITY COMPARISON: Empress's Grace rewards strict stack sequencing; Order of the Emperor (the other identity) rewards rapid card drawing and card power. These are fundamentally different skill expressions from the same base kit. 4) Cards with 'instant skill cooldown refresh' create situations where two Ruin skills fire in rapid succession — possible 8-stack equivalent burst with cooldown reset proc. Unpredictable but high ceiling.
stabilization_patch: Empress's Grace (Stack-Ruin) has been the dominant Arcanist identity since global launch; Order of the Emperor rises and falls with balance patches.
tier_standing_release: B-tier at launch (Arcanist considered high skill-floor)
tier_standing_current: S-tier (Manillagames January 2026 list: 'Arcanist' listed as S-tier; both identities benefit from T4 damage scaling). HONING-CONFOUND NOTE: Arcanist's tier placement improved significantly with T4 damage ceiling — the 4-stack burst becomes devastating at high Spell Power.

ark_passive_path: Enlightenment — Order of the Emperor branch
honing_confound: Emperor card damage scales with Spell Power (gear honing). Normal skill amplification (Royal card +50%) also gear-indexed. Tier standing fluctuates more with balance patches than Empress's Grace.

delivery.evidence: Same base skill set as Empress's Grace. Emperor identity emphasizes Normal skills — these are the full Arcanist ranged attack arsenal rather than the specialized Stacking/Ruin subset.

footprint.evidence: Same as Empress's Grace. Emperor cards may have wider delivery effects — not confirmed from live sources.

geo_text: Same medium-range card-caster spatial identity. Emperor identity shifts priority: instead of tracking stacks on target, the player maximizes Deck Meter gain to draw cards more often. The Emperor, Royal, and Chancellor cards (exclusive to this engraving) are the damage amplifiers.

control.evidence: Same as Empress's Grace. No CC focus.

economy.resource_verbatim: Arcane Energy (Deck Meter) — enhanced generation in Order of the Emperor
economy.builder_source: ALL skills fill Deck Meter. Order of the Emperor BONUS: Deck Meter gain significantly increased → cards draw faster.
economy.plain_text: CARD-DRAW ECONOMY: Order of the Emperor increases overall Deck Meter gain — cards draw faster. THREE EXCLUSIVE CARDS added to the deck: (1) Emperor card = massive single-hit damage (the identity's primary burst); (2) Royal card = +50% Normal skill damage for 4.0 seconds (short burst amplifier); (3) Chancellor card (utility). Strategy: play Normal skills to fill Deck Meter rapidly, draw cards frequently, time Emperor card use with highest-damage Normal skill cast. Higher APM than Empress's Grace due to normal-skill focus.

movement.evidence: Same as Empress's Grace. Higher APM may translate to more repositioning opportunities between casts.

tempo.evidence: Emperor card procs are the identity burst. Normal skill + Royal card windows create micro-bursts within the rotation. Faster cycling than Empress's Grace but same overall burst-pattern structure.

amp.value: Emperor card: massive single-hit damage; Royal card: +50% Normal skill damage for 4s; Deck generation: significantly increased (faster card access)
amp.evidence: Directly sourced: 'Emperor inflicting massive damage during burst windows. Royal increases the damage of Normal Skills by 50% for 4.0 seconds. Deck Meter gain and overall damage increased.'

proxy.evidence: Cards are effects, not persistent entities.

commitment.evidence: Same skill pool — Emperor card trigger may have its own animation.

mechanics_notes: 1) Emperor is the more chaotic identity — Random card draws + exclusive Emperor/Royal/Chancellor procs create less predictable but higher APM gameplay. Community describes Order of the Emperor as 'constantly draws cards — overall even faster APM than Empress's Grace.' 2) Emperor card as a single-hit massive damage proc is a 'jackpot' mechanic — one card draw provides disproportionate output. This is unusual in LA where damage is generally more distributed. 3) The Chancellor card effect is undocumented in live sourced content — UPGRADE-OWED. 4) Normal skill focus means Order of the Emperor has more skill diversity in its rotation (doesn't lock into Stacking/Ruin subset). This gives the identity a 'use everything' feel vs Empress's Grace's 'stack-ruin loop' discipline. 5) ROTATION NOTE: 'Constantly draws cards' + 'higher APM' signals a higher mechanical demand class identity — rewards fast accurate play more than Empress's Grace's deliberate sequencing.
stabilization_patch: Order of the Emperor is tier-variable — rises when Normal skill damage is buffed, falls when nerfed. Less stable tier standing than Empress's Grace.
tier_standing_current: A/S-tier depending on current patch balance (2025-2026). HONING-CONFOUND NOTE: same Spell Power scaling as Empress's Grace.
